name: gizza-ai/markdown-query
summary: Extract headings, links, images, code blocks, or tables from Markdown

tool.description: Query a Markdown document like jq for markup. Set extract to headings (default), links, images, code_blocks, or tables to pull out that element. format is text (human-readable, default), json (structured {count, items}), or markdown (reconstructed Markdown). include_line_numbers annotates each item with its 1-based source line. Returns the extracted items in the chosen format.

extract.description: Which elements to pull out: headings (default), links, images, code_blocks, or tables.

format.description: Output format: text (human-readable, default), json (structured {count, items}), or markdown (reconstructed Markdown for each item).

include_line_numbers.description: Annotate each item with the 1-based source line it starts on. Default false.
